title: Белая ночь: находки
elevatorPitch: Спокойный поиск вещей в мусорном баке петербургского двора белой ночью.
playerFantasy: Замечать маленькие сокровища в забытых вещах
controls: tap bin or search button three times
progression: 12 interesting objects + 6 junk objects; unique catalog, duplicates marked; local save
difficulty: No timer, no loss, weighted rarities
visualDirection: White night in Saint Petersburg; realistic procedural geometry, PBR materials, soft shadows, aged courtyard; Three.js; no AAA claim
winCondition: All 18 unique finds kept; completion notification, continue searching
loseCondition: None by explicit user selection; discard is a reversible choice through future finds
acceptanceCriteria: Search opens exactly one object after three taps
Discard does not add collection entry
Keep adds unique entry; duplicates do not inflate progress
All 18 objects can be displayed and collected
Completion state at 18/18 and reset works
Static production build works under subpath with local assets and offline after cache

visualRevision.requested: Для начала неплохо, но надо сделать графику в пару раз лучше, а находки детальнее
visualRevision.implemented: PBR environment maps, high-quality contact shadows, detailed geometry and labels on all finds, inspection close-up, material batching; gameplay and save IDs unchanged

visualIterationsV3.request: Хорошо. Приступай к реализации. Как сделаешь три итерации - пуш
visualIterationsV3.implemented: Three bounded passes: perspective-safe staging; priority cast models/materials; display-encoded archive thumbnails and readable UI. Mechanics and save schema unchanged.

visualIterationsV4.request: Хорошо. Сделай ещё 3 итерации и тоже запуш
visualIterationsV4.implemented: Iterations 4–6: inhabited courtyard/bin; localized item wear and highlights; staged reveal/feedback. Book warp reverted to preserve its print. Saves, IDs, silence and rules unchanged.

visualIterationsV5.implemented: 7 twilight lighting; 8 coherent landscape panel; 9 accessible view presets, rotation/off-axis-safe fit, stage-relative lights and outward underside print. No changes to rules, IDs, saves or silence.

visualIterationsV8.request: В Игре Белая ночь убери балконы, сделай 4 сторону двора, но с аркой и воротами. Почитай skills и постарайся увеличить fps без потери качества. Также на небе сделай звёзды и луну и соответственно угол обзора поднимающий голову к небу
visualIterationsV8.implemented: Balconies removed; fourth side closes the well with a real arched passage, iron gates, alley, lamp and roof band; static star field (1150 points) and moon with halo; drag look-up camera in the search phase; scenery tessellation/batching, hidden veiled yard during inspection, 2x MSAA and adaptive render scale on touch. Items, saves, rules, silence unchanged.
